reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Acceleration of Malaria Elimination in Indonesia - Indonesia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Indonesia, Malaria, Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control, Ministry of Health of The Republic of Indonesia (MOH)This program has the following goals: 86% of the Indonesian territory is free of malaria transmission, and no district with annual parasite incidence (API) > 1 per 1000 at-risk populations by the end of 2026.. The objectives of this program are: Increased in number of malaria-free districts from 347 districts in 2022 to 445 districts in 2026.. Achieved positivity rate for Papua province (along with the newly created province) <5% by the end of 2026.. Malaria elimination status is maintained in districts determined to achieve malaria elimination.
